issues.description: The solution marks Developer.attend(course:) as private, while the problem statement and template expect an instance method accessible from other files (Client calls attend). Declaring the method private prevents Client (in a different file) from calling it, causing compile errors or test failures and contradicting the intended use described in the exercise.
issues.suggested_fix: Make attend(course:) non-private so it is callable from Client and other files. For example, change the method declaration in solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift from `private func attend(course: Course?)` to `func attend(course: Course?)` (or `public func attend(course: Course?)` if an explicit public API is desired). This aligns the solution with the template and the problem description.
